title: Guy Banister, 544 Camp Street and the FBI's 'real X-Files' UFO collection

tellings.quote: >> And and he was operating before shooting him out of 554 Camp Street or 544 Camp Street in New Orleans. The guy that owned that building was Guy Banister, who was a very prominent FBI guy who ran the X-Files at the time, which was the UFO Collections, The Real X-Files, which is what the show is based on.

plain: Before he shot President Kennedy in 1963, Lee Harvey Oswald was working out of a building at 544 Camp Street in New Orleans, and that building was owned by Guy Banister, a prominent FBI man who, according to Michels, ran the bureau's UFO collection, the "real X-Files" that the television show was based on. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation with Joe Rogan, as a link between the Kennedy killing and government UFO secrets.
